text:
alex: heads-up, getting reports of broken correlation between traces and logs for inference-gpu in eu-west1 around 03:40 UTC
mira: noticed high index_write_latency in Kibana and lots of short/truncated trace ids in raw logs :alarm_clock:
raj: deploy-bot shows a rollout at 03:22 that updated our log serializer in inference-gpu -> v2.3.1
deploy-bot: deployment/inference-gpu rolled to v2.3.1 by @raj
jules: loki push metrics look spiky, but our alert thresholds for loki_ingester_queue_size are still green — maybe too permissive
sam: ran a quick Loki query: `{app="inference-gpu"} |= "trace_id" | json` and we get many `trace_id=abc123...` truncated entries, some with literal `\\n` embedded
raj: pulled a pod log: `2026-02-14T03:39:58Z inference-gpu[pid=312] trace_id=abc123... msg=\"step done\"` — the trace_id is elided before write
alex: ran `kubectl logs -n loki loki-ingester-2 | tail -n 120` and see `ERROR serializer: field overflow, dropped remainder` repeated
mira: serializer change note in PR mentioned switching to compact-hex to save 30% bytes; maybe it mishandles multiline messages or NULs
sam: impact: fragmented trace ids break cross-product dashboards (Kibana + Jaeger/Grafana traces) and our SLOs that rely on exact trace_id joins will undercount failures
raj: rolling back inference-gpu to v2.3.0 across eu-west1 canary (2 nodes) now, will monitor
ops-bot: rollback initiated by raj — deployment/inference-gpu -> v2.3.0 (canary)
mira: after rollback, full-length trace_ids reappearing in Kibana within ~45s and indexing lag drops on Grafana panels
alex: mitigation checklist: 1) rollback (done), 2) hotfix serializer to preserve full trace_id and avoid truncation on multiline logs (raj + eng-runtime), 3) add unit test including `\\n` and long fields (devex), 4) lower loki_ingester_queue_size alert and add an ad-hoc metric for trace_id length distribution (eng-sre)
sam: suggestion: emit a `trace_id_len` label/count from application logs or via promtail pipeline so we have a stable metric
jules: I'll add a brief incident note in #incidents once root cause confirmed and patch merged
raj: filing PR for serializer patch now, will include a compatibility flag to revert to compact-hex if storage pressure is critical
mira: in the short term I'll create a recording rule to detect trace id fragmentation: `- record: loki_traceid_frag_rate
  expr: sum(rate(({job=~"loki.*"} |= "trace_id") [5m])) by (instance) / sum(rate(({job=~"loki.*"} |= "trace_id" | json | __error__!="") [5m])) by (instance)` — crude but gives signal
alex: also add dashboard panel: 95th percentile trace_id length over 5m and an alert if p95 < expected length
sam: FYI this affected a few downstream SLO queries in staging earlier today; recommend we run a replay on staging logs to validate fix before full prod rollout
raj: agreed, will promote hotfix to staging first, run replay smoke, then roll to prod eu-west1
ops-bot: reminder: update runbook with `serializer.rollback` steps and a snippet for the `kubectl rollout undo` command
alex: thanks team — good catch. once PR is open paste link here and we'll track until merged and green.
